```{r}
setwd("D:/译后编辑实验/博士论文数据")
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
Covariates <- read_xlsx("Covariates_updated.xlsx")
```

```{r}
attach(Covariates)
Profile <- as.factor(Profile)
```
```{r}
anova<-aov(English~Profile)
summary(anova)
```

```{r}
res<-anova$residuals
shapiro.test(res)
hist(res, main="Histogram of residuals",xlab="residuals")
```

```{r}
library(car)
leveneTest(English~Profile)
```

```{r}
library(emmeans)
# 计算 profile 各组的边际均值
emm <- emmeans(anova, ~ Profile)

# 进行两两比较，使用 Tukey 进行多重比较校正
pairs(emm, adjust = "tukey")

```
